name: dayflow-electron
description: Ask about your day. Dayflow Electron's timeline of what you worked on, read locally from your computer.

interface.shortDescription: Your day's timeline, from the Dayflow Electron app.
interface.longDescription: Dayflow Electron records what you work on and turns it into a timeline. This plugin lets you ask where your time went and draft standups and weekly reviews from it. Everything is read from the Dayflow Electron app on this computer; nothing is uploaded by the plugin.
defaultPrompt: @Dayflow Electron what did I work on today?
@Dayflow Electron where did my time go this week?
@Dayflow Electron write my standup from yesterday.
